title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and bump GH Actions + node deps
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Our GitHub Actions matrix has diverged across repos and retained legacy Node versions and duplicated lint/test/release steps. This PR consolidates reusable workflow templates, upgrades our GH Actions to recommended actions versions, standardizes Node runtime to 20.x across JS/TS jobs, and performs a hygiene pass to remove deprecated steps. Changes include: unified .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} into templates at .github/workflows/templates and call-workflows using workflow_call; replaced multiple action pins with maintained v3/v4 tags where appropriate; consolidated cache keys and improved job-level caching for the monorepo layout; extracted common steps into composite actions under .github/actions/ci-helpers; bumped node-version from 18 -> 20 for build and test jobs; updated actions/checkout/setup-node/setup-python/actions/cache versions for security and performance; removed legacy matrix entries and duplicated job definitions; added a migration note for on-prem CI runners to update runner images. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and add workflow_call templates; - [x] Bump GH Actions and Node to 20.x; - [x] Add composite actions for common steps; - [x] Update caching strategy and keys; - [x] Run full CI across redwood, sdks, and examples; - [x] Add migration notes in CONTRIBUTING.md. Testing: ran workflow dispatch across redwood and sdk repos with matrix = [node:20, os:ubuntu-latest] and reran failing flaky test with increased timeout; ran local act-based smoke-run for the templates. Migration plan: merge to main, monitor CI for 48h and revert via hotfix branch if regressions appear. Impact: low-risk infra changes; no code behavioral changes. See related work: ENG-4321 (CI unification), ENG-4387 (actions security audit).
